segments.text: The Scorpio-N makes 203 horsepower — and on the top model, full Level 2 ADAS. A body-on-frame tank that thinks?!
Go diesel 4x4 and it twists out 400 Nm through 4XPLOR terrain modes with real 4-Low. This tank means business.
The range runs ₹13.49 to 24.95 lakh — and the loaded Z8L throws in a Sony 12-speaker and six airbags.
Body-on-frame, 4x4, Level-2 ADAS — Mahindra, how is this even legal? Fortuner owners are sweating. Smash like if you'd buy it.

pops.anchor: Smash like if you'd buy it

segments.text: Scorpio-N or Fortuner — which one wins? Comment 1 or 2! Like, share, subscribe. Still think a tank can't think?
